subject: PO acceptance rules, vendor registration fields, and sample invoice for Greenstone
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@greenstone-retail.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Vendor record request + PO-match rules for upcoming program

Hi Irene,

We're starting the supplier onboarding for the new merchandising program and need to create Redwood Inference as a vendor in our AP system. Before we kick off the portal registration, can you confirm the vendor details and provide the documents below? I included our minimum PO/invoice matching requirements so you can validate your invoice template in advance.

Required vendor fields and docs:
- Legal business name (as it should appear on invoices)
- Remit-to address and preferred payment method (ACH/SEPA/Wire)
- Tax identifier (TIN for US, VAT or VAT registration certificate for EU)
- W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) and/or VAT certificate PDF
- Bank details (account number, routing/BIC/IBAN) — we support masked uploads
- Primary AP contact (name, email, phone)

PO/invoice matching rules (critical for automated acceptance):
- The system requires a "PO fingerprint": a 12-character token used for auto-matching. For Greenstone that is PO number (8 chars) + vendor code (4 chars) with no separators.
- Each invoice must include the PO number on the header line and as a separate invoice field named "PO-Fingerprint" where possible.
- Line-level PO references are preferred for multi-PO invoices.
- Invoices lacking a recognizable PO fingerprint will go to manual review and delay payment cycles.

Attached is Greenstone's vendor registration form and a short portal registration link — please complete and return the form, or register directly in the portal. If you prefer, you can upload the docs into the portal and we'll take it from there.

Can you get the vendor packet and a sample invoice over by next Tuesday (14 Dec)? That will let us create the vendor record and run a test invoice match the week of 20 Dec.

Appreciate it — let me know if any of the requirements are unclear.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
Greenstone Retail
accounts-payable@greenstone-retail.com
+1 312-555-0142

Thanks — we can complete this on our side. Quick answers and attachments below.

Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Remit address: 1122 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
Preferred payment method: ACH (US) — we can support wire and international bank transfers for EU/UK via IBAN+BIC.
Tax ID: US EIN 81-1234567 (W-9 attached). For EU customers, we can provide a VAT registration certificate or EU VAT number on request.
Primary AP contact: Jordan Blake — jordan.blake@redwood.com / +1 415-555-0199

Bank details (for ACH payouts):
- Bank: Redwood Bank (example)
- Account: ****1234
- Routing: 021000021
(We will provide full details via the portal or masked upload per your security guidance.)

Attachments included: Redwood_Sample_Invoice_PO91427.pdf (sample invoice formatted for your rules), Signed_W9_Redwood.pdf, and a completed copy of Greenstone's registration form (filled).

A couple of questions on the PO fingerprint so we align perfectly:
1) When you say 8-char PO + 4-char vendor code, can the vendor code be our internal short code (e.g., "RDWD")? If so we'll populate PO-Fingerprint as e.g. 91427RDWD.
2) For multi-PO invoices we can include line-level PO references. Do you also require the PO number in the invoice metadata header (separate field) for automated ingestion?

We'll register via the portal today unless you prefer us to email the filled form instead. Jordan will follow up on the payment routing details to ensure the ACH file is formatted to your spec.

If you confirm the fingerprint pattern and whether you need a separate metadata field we will reissue the sample invoice if necessary.

Best,

Irene — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few clarifications (copying the relevant piece of the spec below):

On Fri, Dec 11, 2026 at 10:02 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> A couple of questions on the PO fingerprint so we align perfectly:
> 1) When you say 8-char PO + 4-char vendor code, can the vendor code be our internal short code (e.g., "RDWD")? If so we'll populate PO-Fingerprint as e.g. 91427RDWD.
> 2) For multi-PO invoices we can include line-level PO references. Do you also require the PO number in the invoice metadata header (separate field) for automated ingestion?

Yes — vendor code must be our assigned four-character vendor code (we'll provide it once the vendor record is created). For testing, put "TEST" as the vendor code and we'll swap the code after onboarding.

We do require both:
- PO-Fingerprint (12 chars) as an invoice field for automated matching.
- A separate header field named "PO Number" for human-readable traceability.

Portal/Doc signing: please register at the portal link and upload your W-9/W-8 and bank details. Alternatively, sign and return the attached DocuSign for the tax packet (link below).

Attached: Greenstone_Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf (please re-upload with vendor code blank — we'll populate it), DocuSign link for tax packet.

We'll create your vendor code within 2 business days of receiving the completed registration and signed tax docs. Once created, we will email the code and request a test invoice. Expect a short manual verification window.

Liam
Senior Manager, Accounts Payable
Greenstone Retail
